title: Machine-learning virtual screening of ZINC20 finds one confirmed RORgamma ligand
summary: Machine-learning models of ligand activity were applied to virtual screening of the ZINC20 database for RORγ/RORγT ligands. Two candidates were tested experimentally and one was confirmed to induce RORγ activity. With a single confirmed hit the evidence of efficacy is limited.
ai_technology: Machine-learning activity models built on molecular descriptors, used for virtual screening
organization: Institute for Medical Biology; Polish Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: Two predicted candidates were experimentally assayed, and one induced RORγ activity.
evidence.unknown: Hit potency, selectivity and the number of compounds screened are not stated. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML models predicted ligand activity to rank ZINC20 compounds for RORγ.
